description: Ministry of Urban Development - The Urban Development Authority Law No. 41 of 1978Declaration and Expansion of Ukuwela PS Area under Section 03
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters - specifically the declaration and expansion of the Ukuwela Urban Development Area. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, Grama Niladhari divisions, and geographical specifications for urban development purposes under the Urban Development Authority Law. The content focuses entirely on land areas, boundaries, and development zones without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other administrative matters that would fall under Types 1-3 or other specialized categories.
